results.abstract: On August 4, 2026, the Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System (Board) published in the Federal Register a proposal that would update Regulation O, the Board's rule governing loans by member banks to their insiders and insiders of their affiliates. The proposal provided for a comment period ending on October 5, 2026. The Board is extending the comment period for 30 days, until November 4, 2026.
